verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only human-facing channels: the Online Filing Centre web portal and PDF forms by email or mail. A fee line mentions a "registered intermediary", but nothing documents a software-to-software transmission channel, system accounts, or a published enrollment path. The probe found no transactional API on any registry surface checked, and the open.canada.ca CKAN endpoint is a separate read-only open-data layer, not a way to transact with the registry.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, a documented system-to-system channel exists for software to transact with the service (system accounts, transmitter programs, batch providers), with the enrollment path published
